user_answer: In PostgreSQL, we optimize queries by analyzing EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution plans to verify index seeks over sequential scans. We establish covering B-tree indexes on foreign keys to accelerate relational joins, and configure read committed isolation to prevent deadlocks while maintaining ACID consistency with sub-20ms query latency.
